summary: Phase 2B full regression + new-feature testing. Added /app/backend/tests/test_phase2b.py with 37 targeted tests covering Student unique ID (STU-YYYY-NNNNN backfill, per-school counters, search-by-id), photo upload (multipart /uploads/photo, MIME + 3MB caps, path traversal, unauth 401), tenant isolation on serve (School A file 404 for School B; super_admin bypass; teacher-same-school allowed), student admission with new fields + receptionist allowed + teacher forbidden (403), student update + photo endpoint role gating + cross-tenant 404, landscape voucher.pdf (application/pdf + %PDF- header + cross-school 404), ID card preview payload + role gating, bulk ID-cards PDF by student_ids and by class_id (400 when neither, 404 when class belongs to another school, teacher allowed, parent/student forbidden), configurable id_card_back_text via /school/settings surfacing in ID card payload, and result-card auto photo_url. Baseline: 52/52 backend_test.py + test_phase2.py PASS (Phase 2A role-scoping fix from iter2 is now confirmed working — parent no longer sees other students on /api/school/students). Phase 2B: 37/37 PASS. Frontend smoke on Preview URL: Students list shows Photo circle + STU-2026-NNNNN column + search; /app/students/{id} StudentProfile renders with 'Change photo', View ID card, and Download ID card PDF; /print/id-card/{sid} shows Front + Back cards with configured back text persisted (TEST_BACK_55174b visible), Print + Download PDF buttons; /print/voucher/{invoiceId} shows 3 copies with Student/Parent/Bank labels + landscape @page CSS + Download PDF button; Settings shows 'ID card back text' textarea. Parent sidebar limited to Dashboard, Fees, Examinations, Timetable, Daily Diary, Notices, Change Password (correct). Developer branding preserved throughout. Total: 89/89 backend tests + 100% frontend smoke.

minor.issue: Dead/unreachable code — after `return doc` at line 249 the same doc-insert block is repeated (lines 250-259). No functional impact but should be removed. Also `next_student_id` is imported inline inside the function body — move to top-level import.

Depends on require_school_active but the review request states super_admin bypasses download only; upload correctly rejects super_admin (no school_id) via 400 — behaviour matches spec but could be more explicit.

Counters index (`await get_db().counters.create_index('key', unique=True)`) is created AFTER backfill runs on startup — race between $inc/upsert and index creation is fine here because startup is serial, but the ordering is fragile. Consider creating index before backfill.

Uses `return_document=True` (truthy) which motor interprets as ReturnDocument.AFTER via the ReturnDocument import — motor accepts pymongo.ReturnDocument.AFTER constant; passing True works but non-canonical. Recommend `from pymongo import ReturnDocument; return_document=ReturnDocument.AFTER`.

Cross-school class returns 404 only because no students matched (`if not students: raise 404`). If the other school happens to have zero students in that class-id — extremely unlikely — it would still 404 but for a different reason. Consider validating class ownership explicitly for clearer semantics.

issues: Photo placeholder shows literal 'Photo' text inside a large square — fine for print but could be styled as an outline icon like the profile page's avatar circle for consistency.

Parent role sees whole-school aggregate counts (Students 35, Teachers 1, Pending Fees 20800) on Dashboard — pre-existing from Phase 1, not a Phase 2B regression. Consider scoping parent dashboard to their own child(ren).

action_items: MINOR: Remove dead code block in routes_school.py::create_student (lines 250-259, unreachable after return).
MINOR: Move `from routes_phase2b import next_student_id` to top of routes_school.py (currently imported inside function).
MINOR: Create counters unique index BEFORE running backfill_student_ids() in server.py startup for safer ordering.
MINOR: Use pymongo.ReturnDocument.AFTER instead of `return_document=True` in next_student_id.
OPTIONAL (Phase 1 legacy, not Phase 2B): Scope parent dashboard aggregates to only own children.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_school.create_student has an unreachable duplicated block after `return doc` (dead code) — indicates a merge artifact.

routes_school.list_students::query build order: `if q:` overrides any prior `$or` — fine because we build once, but if role scope also needed a $or we'd have conflicts. Current code path is safe because parent/student role uses `id: {$in:[...]}` restrictor plus name/roll/adm/student_id search.

routes_uploads.py path safety: server checks `if '/' in file_id or '..' in file_id`. FastAPI path param already forbids '/', so the '..' check is the effective guard. A rogue url-encoded traversal is decoded by Starlette before match, so ../ would still be caught. Test asserts 400/404 on '..evil'.

pdf_service.id_cards_pdf: photo is embedded as base64 data URI to avoid xhtml2pdf hitting local file paths — good; but for very large photos this inflates PDF size (~1.3× per photo). Consider Pillow-resize to 200×250 before base64 in _photo_data_uri.

routes_phase2b.voucher_pdf_download reuses routes_extras.fee_voucher() for the payload — good DRY. However that function checks role/tenant internally; the extra `require_school_active` on this endpoint is redundant but harmless.
Uploads collection has no index on file_id — every serve does a full-collection scan on file_id. Add `db.uploads.create_index('file_id', unique=True)`.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (Students list w/ STU-YYYY column + photo + search; Student profile with Change photo/View ID card/Download PDF; /print/id-card front+back with configured back text; /print/voucher 3 landscape copies w/ Download PDF; Settings id_card_back_text; parent sidebar filtered correctly)
